name: Cool Cuts

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kelly Senker
reviewSamples.text: Our Bernedoodle had his first professional cut today and they did amazing work. He was overdue/matted and needed some extra TLC. Very satisfied with their service and would recommend trusting them with your furry friend.
